summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of the minutes of its Ordinary General Meeting held on April 29, 2026. The meeting covered routine matters: approval of 2025 financial statements, allocation of net income and dividend distribution, and fixing management and Audit Committee compensation for 2026. Shareholders representing 95.57% of voting capital attended. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change occurred. This is a standard annual shareholder meeting report, not a special situation filing.
